messages.author: 63cc02caac0434cf
messages.subject: 1 length vectors
parts:
Hello, 

How can you create a 1 length vector? For example,

test <- nimbleFunction(
  
  setup = function() {
    x <- c(1)

  },
  
  run = function() {
    
    print(x[1])
    
    
  },
  
)

gives an error. I often have to index a vector that may have length 1 (although length is variable and often >1) so I am getting errors in my bigger code.

messages.author: 0a8a3bc957877bdf
messages.subject: Re: 1 length vectors
parts:
Hi Dirk,
The easiest way might be that you add a number to x to make it a two-element vector. You will only use x[1] in your run code, so the number added to x does not make any difference. 

Best wishes,
Wei
